source_documents.title: Rigid D-π-A through-space charge-transfer TADF emitter with high radiative rate and fast reverse intersystem crossing for OLEDs

reference_evidence_units.quote: This distinct temperature-dependent delayed emission unambiguously con firms the thermally activated nature of the delayed fluorescence, which is highly consistent with TADF characteristics.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Tz-p-BPO
reference_evidence_units.statement: Delayed fluorescence grows from 28.9% to 58.7% with temperature.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Consequently, Tz-p-BPO simultaneously exhibits a small ΔEST of 0.07 eV and a high photoluminescence quantum yield (ФPL) of 93% in a 3 wt% doped film, together with a kr of 3.23 × 107 s− 1 and a kRISC of 2.70 × 105 s− 1.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Tz-p-BPO
reference_evidence_units.statement: Small ΔEST, fast RISC and kr retained.

reference_evidence_units.quote: and the small energy gaps between them (0.01 and 0.13 eV, respectively) lead to spin-orbit coupling matrix elements
reference_evidence_units.subject: Tz-p-BPO
reference_evidence_units.statement: S1-T2/T3 gaps and SOC open high-lying RISC channels.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The absorption band in the 390-430 nm range corresponds to the CT state transition from the BPO donor unit to the acceptor unit (Tz) in this TSCT-TADF molecule, indicating strong non-covalent donor–acceptor interactions.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Tz-p-BPO

reference_evidence_units.quote: The CT nature is further supported by polarity-dependent PL measurements
reference_evidence_units.subject: Tz-p-BPO

reference_evidence_units.quote: These non-covalent in teractions enhance molecular rigidity and restrict intramolecular vibrations, thereby suppressing non-radiative transitions in the aggre gated state, reducing excited-state energy loss, and ultimately contrib uting to an enhanced fluorescence quantum yield (ФPL) [40].
reference_evidence_units.subject: Tz-p-BPO
reference_evidence_units.statement: Intramolecular D-A stacking rigidifies the molecule.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No specific motion identified or tested.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Emission is from a through-space donor-acceptor CT state, central to the design.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The design aims to keep a high kr while ΔEST is small; kr is reported and discussed as an outcome rather than used to explain a change.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Temperature-dependent delayed fluorescence confirms TADF; RISC via T2/T3 with SOC.
